mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE has been above 5.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based slowdown in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 100 for two consecutive months), supply chain disruptions and reduced industrial output lead to lower corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months signals strong consumer confidence and increased residential investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST has increased for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-tightening monetary policy phase (FEDFUNDS above 2.0% for three consecutive months), the market prices in higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been above 2.0% for three consecutive months.
